headline: Artificial Intelligence: 70% of Large Greek Companies Use It - What a Study by the ECB Shows
summary: An ECB study shows about 70% of large Greek companies use artificial intelligence. The dominant reasons for AI use are broadly similar to those of companies across the rest of the eurozone.
why: The European Central Bank studies business adoption of technology across the eurozone, and AI uptake affects productivity and competitiveness of firms.
